emails.subject: GSTIN correction needed: invoice 01089 dated 18-09-2026
emails.body:
Dear Verma & Co team,

We are writing on behalf of our client Doshi, Ramaswamy and Palan Pvt Ltd (GSTIN 29MUUCV6688X1ZR) about their purchase reconciliation for Sep 2026.

In our GSTR-2B for Sep 2026, invoice 01089 dated 18-09-2026 for Rs 2,31,681.20 is reported under GSTIN 07RJIFW7752C3ZX, not under your GSTIN 29RJIFW7752C1ZT shown on the invoice.

Evidence: same no.+amount in 2B under OTHER GSTIN 07RJIFW7752C3ZX (row 09-006, Rs 231681.2)

Requested fix: Please amend this invoice in your GSTR-1 (Table 9A) so that it is reported under GSTIN 29RJIFW7752C1ZT, with recipient GSTIN 29MUUCV6688X1ZR, or confirm in writing which GSTIN is correct and issue a revised invoice.

Invoice details:
  Invoice no.: 01089
  Invoice date: 18-09-2026
  Your GSTIN: 29RJIFW7752C1ZT
  Taxable value: Rs 1,96,340.00
  Invoice total: Rs 2,31,681.20

Thank you for your help.

Regards,
Accounts team (on behalf of the client)
